dict.string: Windows games launched through MacNeutron may request microphone access for voice chat and audio input.
Windows games launched through MacNeutron may request camera access for video input.
Windows games launched through MacNeutron may use Bluetooth to communicate with game controllers and peripherals.
Windows games launched through MacNeutron may use the local network for LAN multiplayer and discovery.
Windows games launched through MacNeutron may monitor keyboard and controller input while playing.
